subject: planner: fix an unexpected result of the inlineprojection of TopN (#58771)
summary: Reviewed the LogicalTopN.PruneColumns change that snapshots parent-used columns, prunes child with ORDER BY columns, and delays InlineProjection to avoid incorrect TopN output/schema when the parent consumes no columns (e.g., COUNT(*)-style parents). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in upstream history affecting this area.
